name: llms.txt
summary: A proposal for a Markdown file at /llms.txt that gives language models a short summary of a site and a curated list of links. Jeremy Howard of Answer.AI published it in September 2024; version 2 of the proposal (August 2026) also recommends clean .md versions of pages, linked with rel="alternate" and rel="describedby".
facts: Markdown: H1, blockquote summary, H2 link lists, "Optional" section
/llms.txt at a site root or any subpath
Mintlify, GitBook, Yoast SEO, AIOSEO, Wix
goodFor: Pointing agents at the right docs pages
watchOut: A proposal, not a formal standard
Only helps agents that look for it
Read-only: it describes a site but adds no actions
